trial_court: Unknown Court, Writ Petition No. 7127 (M/B) of 2010
case_name: Smt. Gayatri Devi & Others v. State Of U.P., Thru. Prin. Secy.,Home & ...

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Gayatri Devi and others (mother-in-law, etc.)
parties.respondent_defendant: State of U.P and others (opposite parties)

facts_of_case: Marriage of Renuka Saini was solemnised with Manoj Kumar Saini in 2000. Husband and family members demanded Rs.50,000/- but she never moved any complaint. She lodged FIR against petitioners for harassment.

legal_principles.principle: A person who lodges a false FIR can be held liable for harassment and pressure.
legal_principles.held: The submission of learned counsel for the petitioners is that the marriage of opposite party No.4 Renuka Saini was solemnised with Manoj Kumar Saini in the year 2000. Since then her husband and his family members were demanding Rs.50,000/- but she never moved any complaint either to Police or any Officer.

legal_principles.principle: A person who files a petition for dissolution of marriage cannot be allowed to file a false FIR against the other party.
legal_principles.held: The husband of opposite party No.4 has already filed a petition under Section 13 of the Hindu marriage Act, 1955 against her for dissolution of marriage.

outcome.final_order: Petitioners will not be arrested till next date of listing, subject to their cooperation in the investigation.

use_for_drafting: quashing FIR in domestic violence cases
